## Final submission candidate (complete artifact registration)

All ten required files plus the analysis script are present on disk and are registered below with their exact native relative paths as artifact keys. The methods, numerics, and diagnostics are unchanged from the previously approved result (RMSD 0.0711 Å fwd/bwd; 4-point inner λ 0.5688 eV; outer λ 0.7340 eV; total λ 1.3029 eV; rate peak grid 40272 @ −1.3058 eV, k≈1.13e11 s⁻¹; inverted region detected, first inverted grid 39289 @ −1.2761 eV; all contract shapes/columns/keys and the 61-row grid order preserved).

Artifact inventory (verified present on disk with sizes):
- `analysis.py` (21,900 B) — executed end-to-end (exit 0), fully reproducible, creates results/ itself, auto-falls back to a pure-numpy PNG renderer (`plot_utils.py`) when matplotlib is unavailable.
- `results/aligned_displacement_mw.npy` (2,21) — mass-weighted aligned displacements fwd/bwd (aligned source − reference target, ascending site order).
- `results/vibrational_basis_mw.npy` (2,21,15) — retained 15 mass-weighted normal modes per frame (6 null modes removed).
- `results/mode_overlap.npy` (2,15,15) — magnitude-based cross-frame mode overlaps (fwd = |L_AᵀL_B|, bwd = transpose).
- `results/projected_displacement_mw.npy` (2,21) — displacement projected onto the target frame's retained basis (rigid/null content removed, sign preserved).
- `results/transported_mode_projection.npy` (2,15,2) — signed modal coordinates + per-mode inner λ for source modes transported into the target frame.
- `results/lambda_summary.csv` — all 8 required columns.
- `results/mode_projection.npy` (2,15,3) — [signed Q, per-mode λ eV, frequency cm⁻¹] on target modes.
- `results/rate_curve.csv` — 61 rows, grid_id/axis preserved in supplied order, k_et_s_inv and log10_k_et_s_inv.
- `results/diagnostics.json` — all 17 required keys.
- `results/overview.png` — valid 1800×1200 PNG (2×3 panels described previously).

All artifacts were validated programmatically (shapes, columns, keys, row order, mutual consistency of lambda/mode-projection/rate/diagnostics, PNG signature). This candidate satisfies the public submission contract in both content and required artifact registration.
